title: The Past, Person By Person
label: ch:ar-the-past-person-by-person
canDo: I can say what I do now and what I did, for every person, and paint the scene of a story with kāna and the present.

payoff.summary: Complete AR-R283-the-past-person-by-person: a scene with kāna and the present, and the event that cut into it, joined with ḥīnamā.
